目标语言（切一下就会按新语言重翻）: Target language (switching it re-translates right away)
选中文字点横条上的「译」，或在识别结果窗点「翻译」: With text selected, click the translate button on the bar — or click “Translate” in the recognition result window
把当前选的语言设为默认：以后从横条 / 识别结果窗打开翻译窗时，默认就翻成它: Make the selected language the default — the translate window will open with it next time (from the bar or the recognition window)
可以改，改完再点一次「翻译」: Editable — change it and click Translate again
要翻译的文字会出现在这里；空着也可以自己粘贴一段（Ctrl+Enter 直接翻）: The text to translate shows up here; you can also paste your own (Ctrl+Enter to translate)
按上面选的目标语言翻译（Ctrl+Enter）: Translate into the language selected above (Ctrl+Enter)
复制译文到剪贴板: Copy the translation to the clipboard
复制原文到剪贴板: Copy the source text to the clipboard
清空原文和译文: Clear the source text and the translation
正在调模型，长段落可能要等几秒…: Calling the model — long text may take a few seconds…
当前使用的模型（设置 → 翻译 里改）: Current model (change it under Settings → Translate)
把识别出的文字送进翻译窗口: Send the recognized text to the translate window
翻译：把横条此刻这段文字翻成别的语言（默认中文）: Translate: send the bar’s current text to the translate window (Chinese by default)
走硅基流动（SiliconFlow）的 OpenAI 兼容接口，把一段文字翻成另: Uses SiliconFlow’s OpenAI-compatible API to translate text into another language. Create the API key under API management in the SiliconFlow console (new accounts get a free quota); once it’s filled in, click “Test connection” below to really translate one sentence. How to apply for a key and how to troubleshoot: see Help ⑥ · Translate.
关掉后横条翻译按钮、识别结果窗里的翻译入口一并失效: When off, the translate button on the bar and the entry in the recognition window both stop working
形如 sk-…… 的一串；只存在本机（整个配置文件是加密信封），不会随备份明文外: A string like sk-……; kept only on this machine (the whole config file is an encrypted envelope) and never exported in plain text with backups
默认 Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（文本模型，免费档也能跑）: Default: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (a text model that also runs on the free tier); change it here to use another text model
默认 https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1；换成自建网关或: Default: https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 — change it to point at your own gateway or another compatible service
翻译窗口打开时默认翻成它；窗口里还能临时切别的: The translate window opens with this language; you can still pick another one inside the window
去控制台申请 Key: Get a key from the console
把翻译按钮放到横条上，之后可以拖到任意位置: Put the translate button on the bar; afterwards you can drag it anywhere
点一下翻译横条上的文字 · 拖它可以改位置: Click to translate the bar’s text · drag to move it
自定义图标 · 点一下翻译横条上的文字 · 拖它可以改位置: Custom icon · click to translate the bar’s text · drag to move it
走各家的 OpenAI 兼容接口，把一段文字翻成另一种语言。点下面一行 = 设为: Uses each provider’s OpenAI-compatible API to translate text into another language. Click a row below to make it the default engine (every translation uses it); expand that row to fill in the key and pick a model. The engines ticked under “Translate together” run alongside the default one, and the translate window shows one text box per engine. How to apply for a key and how to troubleshoot: see Help ⑥ · Translate.
点一行 = 设为默认引擎；「?」开官方申请页，「文档」开接口文档。凭据填在展开的: Click a row to make it the default engine; “?” opens the official API signup page and “Docs” the API reference. Credentials go in the expanded row
这一家是默认引擎：每次翻译一定用它: This is the default engine: every translation uses it
还没填凭据 —— 一起翻时它那一格会显示失败原因: No credentials yet — its box will show why it failed
选用这个模型（名字看着能对话）: Use this model (the name suggests it can chat)
真翻一句固定的话，确认 Key / 地址 / 模型名是不是真的能用: Really translates one fixed sentence to confirm the key, base URL and model name actually work
这一家的译文会出现在这里…: This engine’s translation shows up here…
还没有配翻译引擎：去 设置 → 翻译 选一家（默认引擎），想一起翻就再勾几家: No translate engine yet: pick one under Settings → Translate (the default engine), and tick a few more under “Translate together” if you want several at once
复制当前选中的那块译文（先点一下哪个框就复制哪个）: Copy the translation in the box you last clicked
清空原文和所有译文: Clear the source text and every translation
